faq: Base44 has a free plan. Paid plans run from $20/month (Starter) to $200/month (Elite) on monthly billing, or $16 to $160 per month billed annually.
Yes. The Free plan gives 25 message credits and 100 integration credits per month, for up to 5 apps.
Annual billing costs 20% less than monthly and adds a free domain for 1 year (Starter and up) and 25 credits to share with a friend (Builder and up). You pay for the full year up front.

Base44 describes credits as your monthly usage allowance for AI messages and integration actions. Message credits and integration credits are counted separately, and usage per action varies with the AI model you select.
